2438-2459-5006-8170.easyPrerequisites:
You can pay for Rograkh's commander tax if applicable.
You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Rograkh is starting in your graveyard.
2438-2459-5006-8170.description:
Cast Rograkh by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Rograkh spell. Then, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Rograkh, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder
Repeat.

710-2292-8207.easyPrerequisites: Ferocity of the Hunt attached to Danitha.
710-2292-8207.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Danitha
When Danitha dies, Ferocity of the Hunt triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Ferocity of the Hunt from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

222-527-4359-6495.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-4359-6495.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Evereth twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.
222-527-4359-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

654-4094-4772-7824-7942.easyPrerequisites: At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
654-4094-4772-7824-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers eight times, untapping the New Planet tokens.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

1283-2034-6970-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {3} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 5 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

2921-3234-3946-7776.description:
While Glacial Chasm is on the battlefield, all damage that would be dealt to you is prevented.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Glacial Chasm triggers. Choose not to pay its cumulative upkeep cost and sacrifice it.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, its second ability triggers, returning Glacial Chasm and Mortuary Mire from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Glacial Chasm and Mortuary Mire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Glacial Chasm trigger, sacrificing Mortuary Mire.
Resolve the Mortuary Mire trigger, putting World Shaper from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 3.
Move to your next turn, drawing World Shaper during your draw step.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Glacial Chasm triggers. Choose not to pay its cumulative upkeep cost and sacrifice it.
Cast World Shaper by paying {3}{G}.
Repeat from step 3.
2921-3234-3946-7776.notes: If your life total allows, you can instead opt to pay Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep cost. If you do this, you can forego doing this loop during that turn.

1619-2921-4605-5542-6149.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-2921-4605-5542-6149.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Stirring Bard from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Stirring Bard enters, it and Preston trigger twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Stirring Bard.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Stirring Bard that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Stirring Bard token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Stirring Bard token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Stirring Bard that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the first Stirring Bard trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-2921-4605-5542-6149.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

1394-2060-6798-7038-7704.description:
Play Power Depot, which will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Cast Toph either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Toph enters, it triggers, earthbending Power Depot and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Power Depot equal to the mana spent to cast Toph, increased by Doc Samson.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Power Depot.
When Power Depot dies, its modular ability and Toph trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting the +1/+1 counters that were on Power Depot onto Crystalline Crawler, increased by Doc Samson.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Power Depot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Power Depot will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Toph. Choose to return Toph from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat step 10 until you have enough mana to cast Toph.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

5434-5475-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Forensic Researcher.
Activate one of the Forensic Researcher tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Forensic Researcher token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

856-2438-4321-7396.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-2438-4321-7396.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Quintorius, History Chaser trigger.
Resolve the Quintorius, History Chaser trigger, creating a token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

4594-4668-7070.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least two cards this turn.
4594-4668-7070.description:
Activate Spirit en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Spirit en-Kor.
The Spirit en-Kor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Spirit en-Kor from exile by paying {0} due to Heliod
Repeat.

3053-3767-3918-7223.easyPrerequisites: There are at least three basic land types among lands you control
3053-3767-3918-7223.description:
Activate Trazyn using Prismatic Geoscope's ability by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1939-5670-6705.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You control at least one additional creature.
1939-5670-6705.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Luminous Phantom triggers if it's on the battlefield, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token and a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Lunarch Veteran triggers if it's on the battlefield, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

1395-2757-5051-5078.description:
Activate a basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Traxos, untapping a basic land.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Elsha and Traxos trigger.
Resolve the Elsha trigger, giving itself +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Traxos trigger, untapping it.
Repeat.

997-1286-6888.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Ajani's Chosen triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
When Traveling Plague enters, Ajani's Chosen triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat from step 3.

522-1429-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Melira.
Repeat.

997-1580-4871-5111.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.

1669-2653-5531-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have at least two lands between the battlefield and your graveyard.
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn
1669-2653-5531-5702.description:
Play any land.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Holding priority, activate Thaumatog by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 3 until you control no lands.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Lumra.
Put the token Lumra into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and returning all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko and Nissa trigger that many times.
Resolve all Nissa triggers, adding {G} for each trigger.
Resolve all but one Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating that many 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Repeat from step 3.

2231-3180-5220.description:
Cast Chamber Sentry either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Chamber Sentry enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Mortuary triggers, putting Chamber Sentry on top of your library from your graveyard.
Repeat.

369-2386-2579-4050.notablePrerequisites: Pattern of Rebirth attached to Iridescent Drake.
369-2386-2579-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Iridescent Drake, adding one mana of any color.
When Iridescent Drake dies, The Cauldron of Eternity and Pattern of Rebirth trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron of Eternity trigger, putting Iridescent Drake on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Pattern of Rebirth trigger, putting Iridescent Drake from your library onto the battlefield.
When Iridescent Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Pattern of Rebirth from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Iridescent Drake.
Repeat.

876-1766-2043-4365.description:
Activate Thran Dynamo by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating two token copies of Thran Dynamo that are 1/1 Soldiers in addition to their other types.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to a Thran Dynamo token.
Activate the Thran Dynamo token by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat from step 3 using the other Thran Dynamo token.
Repeat from step 2.

2232-3907-4050.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to black is at least four.
2232-3907-4050.description:
Cast Underworld Hermit by paying {4}{B}{B}.
When Underworld Hermit enters the battlefield, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Underworld Hermit trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens equal to your devotion to black.
When the Squirrels enter the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers that many times.
Resolve the first Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Underworld Hermit to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Cloudstone Curio triggers, choosing to return nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Activate Phyrexian Altar six times by sacrificing six Squirrels, adding {4}{B}{B}.
Repeat.
If your devotion to black excluding Underworld Hermit is at least five, this combo will net infinite colored mana.

2185-3581-4053.description:
Activate Kykar by sacrificing Howlgeist, adding {R}.
Howlgeist dies, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the batltefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

331-3059-5253.notablePrerequisites: Brion does not have summoning sickness.
331-3059-5253.description:
Activate Brion by paying {R}, tapping it and sacrificing Malignus, dealing damage equal to two times Malignus's power to target opponent and causing you to gain that much life.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 or less life.
